----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Nikhil Ajmera For Respondent(s) : --
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MUNNURI LAXMAN Order 07/02/2025 1.
The present petition has been filed seeking direction to the Executing Court to expedite the execution proceedings, which have been pending for the last two years without yielding any result.

The grievance of the petitioners is that the petitioners obtained a decree under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 and the compensation was awarded and it was directed the Insurance Company to pay the Smt. sentences.text: In execution of the said award, execution petition was filed before the Executing Court.

Inspite of the several reliefs sought for reaping the fruits of the award, the Executing Court was not able to expedite the proceedings so that the fruits of the award could not be realized by the petitioners.
3. In the said background, the writ petition is disposed of.
The Executing Court is directed to conclude the execution proceedings within a period of three months from the date of receipt of this order.
4. All pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.
